scope: Six component-review findings fixed. Actual component overlays on existing baseline images; no full image build, promotion or full-image security acceptance.

findings.fix: Retire6.1.0 exact-source TLS amendment supplies requested target host on CONNECT socket while omitting IP SNI. Default certificate verification remains enabled.
findings.proof: Real loadrepository:10 combinations across HTTP/HTTPS proxies, valid/wrong DNS and IP SAN, explicit insecure mode. All rejected identities receive zero origin HTTP requests or origin Authorization headers; proxy authentication remains supported.

findings.fix: Complete required files and their installed RECORD identities are bound independently to SHA256-pinned official wheel inventories. The mutable installed RECORD cannot omit or rehash code/licenses/resources into acceptance. Unexpected files, symlinks and nonregular objects are rejected; only explicit installer variations are admitted.
findings.proof: Synthetic regressions plus actual official-wheel executable/license row removal and tamper probes reject before any package bytes change. A rehashed altered source also rejects. Generated bytecode is discarded after all preflight checks.

findings.fix: All source/target trees, resources, write destinations, permissions and generated RECORD are prepared/checked before any mutation.
findings.proof: Missing/symlinked second destination and unwritable target/RECORD regressions preserve complete before/after snapshots. Actual missing second package+removed rows probe rejects before modifying first target.

findings.fix: CA bootstrap parses every PEM block in the effective CAfile and actual active lookup files, including hashed-only entries and local concatenated bundles. OpenSSL multi-certificate output count must equal framed input count, with a per-certificate fallback.
findings.proof: Both Linux architectures reject revoked roots in later bundle/PEM/hash-only entries, malformed/truncated/invalid-DER input and missing trust. Sandbox testing CA stays trusted through CAfile/CApath; G3 rejects through both.

findings.fix: Pip smoke requires a readable, complete effective CA bundle before running checks or emitting a passing absence receipt.
findings.proof: Original verifier with missing SSL_CERT_FILE returned0/pass. Fixed verifier fails missing paths; host permission regression and real pentester unreadable-bundle fixture fail before a passing receipt.

findings.fix: Verified portable runtime resources, including urllib3 emscripten_fetch_worker.js and type markers, are retained; native ABI extension files remain excluded from vendoring.
findings.proof: Unit test and actual wheel repair preserve the worker byte-for-byte from trusted urllib3 source. Pip cache/download/offline install and pure-Python msgpack tests still pass.

inventory_generation: Read exact official wheel ZIP payloads, verify every wheel RECORD entry against payload bytes, then record complete file hashes/sizes independently of the installed tree. Wheel archive hashes match previously qualified lock/provenance receipts. The trusted inventory JSON SHA256 is anchored in repair_pip_vendors.py.

python_tests.command: pytest tests/test_pip_vendor_repair.py tests/test_sandbox_system_ca.py tests/test_retire_tls_patch.py tests/test_sandbox_requirements_lock.py tests/test_sandbox_release_workflow.py tests/test_brotli_install.py tests/test_quality_environments.py -q

linux_components.bounds: serial existing-image fixtures; network none, loopback only;512MB and0.5CPU; pip installation/repair/functional verifier as pentester

real_wheel_probes: omitted executable RECORD row rejected without mutation
omitted license RECORD row rejected without mutation
missing second target rejected before any mutation

omitted license RECORD row rejected without mutation
missing second target rejected before any mutation

remaining_gate: Parent integration, fresh dual-architecture final images, smoke, installed inventory and full security dispositions. Independent system Python and Go lanes were not modified.
